title: 🌿 Panchakarma & Detox Therapy in India
h1: Cleanse, Rejuvenate & Restore Balance with Ayurveda
intro: Panchakarma, meaning “five actions”, is Ayurveda’s most powerful detox and rejuvenation therapy. It is designed to remove toxins (Ama) from the body, restore the natural balance of the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha), and strengthen immunity. International patients often choose Panchakarma in India for chronic health conditions, post-surgery recovery, stress, fatigue, lifestyle-related issues, and preventive wellness & anti-aging.

sections.heading: Benefits of Panchakarma Detox
points: Removes deep-rooted toxins from body & mind
Boosts immunity and natural healing
Improves digestion & metabolism
Reduces stress, anxiety, and fatigue
Supports weight management & hormonal balance
Enhances skin glow, vitality & energy

sections.heading: Core Panchakarma Therapies
points: Vamana (Therapeutic Emesis): Removes excess mucus and toxins from the upper body
Virechana (Purgation Therapy): Cleanses the liver, intestines, and blood
Basti (Medicated Enema): Balances Vata dosha and improves gut health
Nasya (Nasal Therapy): Detoxifies and clears respiratory passages, sinuses, and mind
Raktamokshana (Blood Detox): Purifies blood and helps with skin & autoimmune conditions
Supportive therapies: Abhyanga, Shirodhara, Swedana for complete detox & relaxation

sections.heading: Why Choose Panchakarma in India?
points: Authentic Ayurveda centers with certified doctors (Vaidyas)
Customized detox plans based on your health needs
Affordable therapy packages compared to the West
Healing environments – from Kerala backwaters to Himalayan retreats
Integrative care – Ayurveda + modern medical supervision (if required)

sections.heading: Cost of Panchakarma Therapy in India
points: 7-day Panchakarma Detox Package: $300 – $500
14-day Intensive Detox & Rejuvenation: $600 – $900
21-day Complete Panchakarma Program: $1,000 – $1,500
Cost includes doctor consultation, therapies, accommodation & herbal medicines. Prices vary by center & location.
